answer: A stake-weighted attestation vine resists Sybil attacks by making identity expensive to grow: each agent locks a refundable bond before its endorsements count, and endorsements gain weight only through a history of verified work. An attacker faces a canyon between one cheap fake identity and a trusted reputation — faking hundreds of identities means locking hundreds of bonds, and one detected fraud slashes them all. Honest agents glide on velvet: their bond stays intact, their attestations compound, and the cost of attack stays far above any gain from a fake majority.
